claims.statement: For the exact account03/B19 one-effective core M0=diag(a,-b,0)+lambda(x,y,r)(x,y,r)^T with a,b>=7/8, |lambda|>=41/56, r^2>=27/41, and a normalized disjoint tail aggregate Z=w^T X_T, arbitrary independent cap-one inputs give ||p_Q||_infinity <= 64 sqrt(e)/(3 sqrt(3)) < 20.307.

For A_m=diag(1,-1,0_m)+J_m/m, every physical principal subset of at most K coordinates has s_3<=K/m, while the full form has nonzero spectrum {1,-1,1} and is uniformly controlled after aggregating the full tail.

Extend the exact-core bound uniformly to A=diag(a,-b,D_T)+lambda vv^T+R under the account03/B19 one-effective bounds, where ||R||op<=1/8 and max|D_T|<1/7, without replacing same-bank contamination by independent noise or post-rotation conditioning.
